## Explorer


## Compare Albums

Compare the visual styles, color palettes, and eras of any two albums side-by-side.

```{=html}
<div class="row text-center mt-3 g-4">

    <div class="card shadow-sm border-0 p-3 bg-light h-100" style="border-radius: 16px;">

      <div class="d-flex justify-content-center mb-3" style="min-height: 320px; align-items: center;">

      </div>

<script>
const albums = [

    tracks: 16, runtime: "65 min", aoty: false,
    spotify: "6kZDo2Bmxvf6je80qaDYQZ",
    highlights: "All Too Well, I Knew You Were Trouble"
  },
  { 
    title: "1989", year: 2014, file: "data/05_1989.jpg", num: 5, 
    vibe: "80s Synth-pop / Polaroid Sky", color: "#3d799f",
    bg: "radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(61,121,159,0.22) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.9) 70%)",
    glow: "0 15px 35px rgba(61,121,159,0.35)",
    tracks: 13, runtime: "48 min", aoty: true,
    spotify: "64LU4c1nfjz19WqaKaKyYU",

    title: "reputation", year: 2017, file: "data/06_reputation.jpg", num: 6,

    bg: "radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(80,84,80,0.22) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.9) 70%)",

    tracks: 16, runtime: "63 min", aoty: true,

    glow: "0 15px 35px rgba(40,55,89,0.4)",

    bg: "radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(84,78,69,0.22) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.9) 70%)",
    glow: "0 15px 35px rgba(84,78,69,0.35)",
    tracks: 16, runtime: "65 min", aoty: false,
    spotify: "1Mo4aZ8pdj6k1crs5vdEv0",
    highlights: "Fortnight, I Can Do It With a Broken Heart"
  }
];

// Explorer Elements
const select = document.getElementById("album-select");
const cover = document.getElementById("album-cover");
const title = document.getElementById("album-title");
const meta = document.getElementById("album-meta");
const grid = document.getElementById("thumb-grid");
const vinylLabel = document.getElementById("vinyl-label-img");
const cardContainer = document.getElementById("card-container");
const aotyBadge = document.getElementById("aoty-badge");
const eraStats = document.getElementById("era-stats");
const spotifyPlayer = document.getElementById("spotify-player");
const vinylWrap = document.getElementById("vinyl-wrap");

function showAlbum(index) {
  const a = albums[index];
  cover.src = a.file;
  cover.alt = a.title + " Album Cover";
  vinylLabel.src = a.file;
  title.textContent = a.title;
  title.style.color = a.color;
  meta.textContent = `${a.vibe} • Released in ${a.year} • Studio Album #${a.num}`;
  select.value = index;
  
  // Ambient glow & background styling
  cardContainer.style.background = a.bg;
  cardContainer.style.boxShadow = a.glow;
  
  // AOTY Grammy Badge
  if (a.aoty) {
    aotyBadge.innerHTML = `<span class="badge rounded-pill px-3 py-2 text-white" style="background-color: ${a.color}; font-size: 0.85rem;">🏆 Grammy Album of the Year Winner</span>`;
  } else {
    aotyBadge.innerHTML = "";
  }
  
  // Era Stats Badges
  eraStats.innerHTML = `
    <span class="badge bg-white text-dark border shadow-sm">🎵 ${a.tracks} Tracks</span>
    <span class="badge bg-white text-dark border shadow-sm">⏱️ ${a.runtime}</span>
    <span class="badge bg-white text-dark border shadow-sm">✨ ${a.highlights}</span>
  `;
  
  // Live Spotify Player
  spotifyPlayer.src = `https://open.spotify.com/embed/album/${a.spotify}?utm_source=generator&theme=0`;
  
  // Activate vinyl spin animation
  vinylWrap.classList.remove("is-playing");
  void vinylWrap.offsetWidth; // trigger reflow
  vinylWrap.classList.add("is-playing");
  
  // Thumbnails outline
  document.querySelectorAll(".thumb-btn").forEach((btn, i) => {
    btn.style.outline = (i == index) ? `3px solid ${a.color}` : "none";
    btn.style.opacity = (i == index) ? "1" : "0.65";
  });
}

// Build Thumbnail Navigation
albums.forEach((a, index) => {
  const img = document.createElement("img");
  img.src = a.file;
  img.alt = a.title;
  img.title = `${a.title} (${a.year})`;
  img.className = "thumb-btn rounded shadow-sm";
  img.style = "width: 52px; height: 52px; object-fit: cover; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease;";
  img.onclick = () => showAlbum(index);
  img.onmouseover = () => { if (select.value != index) img.style.opacity = "1"; };
  img.onmouseout = () => { if (select.value != index) img.style.opacity = "0.65"; };
  grid.appendChild(img);
});

select.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
  showAlbum(parseInt(e.target.value));
});

// Comparison Logic
const selLeft = document.getElementById("compare-left");
const selRight = document.getElementById("compare-right");
const imgLeft = document.getElementById("img-left");
const imgRight = document.getElementById("img-right");
const titleLeft = document.getElementById("title-left");
const titleRight = document.getElementById("title-right");
const metaLeft = document.getElementById("meta-left");
const metaRight = document.getElementById("meta-right");

albums.forEach((a, index) => {
  const optL = new Option(`${a.title} (${a.year})`, index);
  const optR = new Option(`${a.title} (${a.year})`, index);
  selLeft.add(optL);
  selRight.add(optR);
});

function updateCompare(side, index) {
  const a = albums[index];
  if (side === "left") {
    imgLeft.src = a.file;
    titleLeft.textContent = a.title;
    titleLeft.style.color = a.color;
    metaLeft.innerHTML = `<strong>${a.vibe}</strong><br>${a.year} • ${a.tracks} tracks • ${a.runtime}<br><small class="text-muted">${a.highlights}</small>`;
  } else {
    imgRight.src = a.file;
    titleRight.textContent = a.title;
    titleRight.style.color = a.color;
    metaRight.innerHTML = `<strong>${a.vibe}</strong><br>${a.year} • ${a.tracks} tracks • ${a.runtime}<br><small class="text-muted">${a.highlights}</small>`;
  }
}

selLeft.addEventListener("change", (e) => updateCompare("left", parseInt(e.target.value)));
selRight.addEventListener("change", (e) => updateCompare("right", parseInt(e.target.value)));

// Random Era Handler
const btnRandom = document.getElementById("btn-random");
if (btnRandom) {
  btnRandom.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const current = parseInt(select.value);
    let next;
    do {
      next = Math.floor(Math.random() * albums.length);
    } while (next === current);
    showAlbum(next);
  });
}

// Initialize with Lover
showAlbum(6);
selLeft.value = 5; // reputation
updateCompare("left", 5);
selRight.value = 6; // Lover
updateCompare("right", 6);
</script>
```

## Era Analytics

Explore how album runtime and track counts have evolved across Taylor Swift's career, highlighted by Grammy Album of the Year victories. Hover over any point to inspect that era's details.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

era_stats <- tibble(
  album = c("Taylor Swift", "Fearless", "Speak Now", "Red", "1989", "reputation", "Lover", "folklore", "evermore", "Midnights", "The Tortured Poets Department"),
  year = c(2006, 2008, 2010, 2012, 2014, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2020, 2022, 2024),
  tracks = c(14, 13, 14, 16, 13, 15, 18, 16, 15, 13, 16),
  runtime = c(53, 53, 67, 65, 48, 55, 61, 63, 60, 44, 65),
  aoty = c("No", "Yes (2010)", "No", "No", "Yes (2016)", "No", "No", "Yes (2021)", "No", "Yes (2024)", "No"),
  color = c("#2b534b", "#c6922e", "#743a6d", "#8b1e2c", "#3d799f", "#1f1f1f", "#d2678f", "#505450", "#784b2c", "#283759", "#544e45")
)

p <- era_stats |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year, 
    y = runtime, 
    size = tracks, 
    color = album, 
    text = paste0("<b>", album, "</b> (", year, ")<br>Runtime: ", runtime, " mins<br>Tracks: ", tracks, "<br>Grammy AOTY: ", aoty)
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(era_stats$color, era_stats$album)) +
  scale_size(range = c(5, 13)) +
  labs(
    title = "Album Runtime & Track Count Across Eras",
    x = "Release Year",
    y = "Runtime (minutes)",
    size = "Tracks"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

:::
